design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The build SHALL use only the Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper, with no Maven or other build tool files added to the repository.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The root `settings.gradle` SHALL include, next to `NaruServe-api` and `NaruServe-servlet`, one module each for the TinyHttpd `HttpAdapter`, the Gson `JsonCodec`, the default bootstrap that backs `RestApp.create()`, the Kotlin extensions, the SLF4J `Logger` adapter, the rotating file `Logger` and the Logcat `Logger`, with final names decided in #1 (the issue proposes `NaruServe-tinyhttpd`, `NaruServe-gson`, `NaruServe`, `NaruServe-kotlin`, and the logger modules take the same `NaruServe-` prefix).

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: Every module of the root build SHALL be configured from the root `build.gradle`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: Modules of the root build MUST NOT carry their own per-module build files.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: Wave 1 SHALL declare every module's main dependencies up front, so later waves add only test-scope dependencies or the release plugins owned by #18.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: Java compilation in every module SHALL use `options.release = 8`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: Kotlin compilation in every module and test source set SHALL use `jvmTarget = 1.8`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The Maven group and the Java package root SHALL be fixed once in #1 (temporary value `com.snoworca.naruserve`) and used by every module.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-api` MUST NOT declare any runtime dependency outside the JDK.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The Gson module SHALL depend on exactly `com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: `kotlin-stdlib` SHALL be a runtime dependency only of the Kotlin extension module, with other modules using it at most in test scope.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-servlet` SHALL depend on `javax.servlet:javax.servlet-api:3.1.0` and `javax.websocket:javax.websocket-api:1.1`, both in `compileOnly` scope only and declared in wave 1, so a later decision for container WebSocket support needs no new main dependency.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The SLF4J adapter module SHALL have `org.slf4j:slf4j-api:1.7.36` as its only main dependency besides `NaruServe-api`, declared in wave 1.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The Logcat `Logger` module SHALL reach `android.util.Log` only through reflection at runtime, with no compile-time Android dependency, so the root build compiles and tests it without an Android SDK.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Gradle wrapper and module layout
design_items.statement: The bootstrap module SHALL declare in wave 1 a main dependency on the Logcat `Logger` module, so wave 5 selects Logcat as the Android default without a later build change.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: `settings.gradle` SHALL include TinyHttpd with `includeBuild`, reading its directory from a Gradle property whose default is `/Users/beom/work/git/TinyHttpd`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd `includeBuild` path MUST NOT be a hard-coded relative path, so builds inside git worktrees resolve it.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: When the configured TinyHttpd directory is missing, the build SHALL fail during configuration with a message naming the property and the path it tried.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: NaruServe modules SHALL reference TinyHttpd only through its Maven coordinates (`com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-core`, `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd:tinyhttpd-websocket`) so Gradle substitutes the included projects.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: Only the TinyHttpd adapter module SHALL depend on TinyHttpd artifacts.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: NaruServe modules MUST NOT depend on `tinyhttpd-router` or `tinyhttpd-session`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: No wave of this run SHALL modify any file inside the TinyHttpd checkout.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: A TinyHttpd gap that the NaruServe adapter cannot fill SHALL be recorded as a deferred issue instead of being patched in TinyHttpd.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / TinyHttpd composite build
design_items.statement: Project documentation SHALL record the TinyHttpd commit the run builds against (46b973e at investigation time).

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Test infrastructure
design_items.statement: Every Java module SHALL use JUnit 4.13.2 for tests.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Test infrastructure
design_items.statement: The build SHALL apply Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.x so Kotlin test sources compile and run inside `./gradlew build`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Test infrastructure
design_items.statement: Wave 1 SHALL add one Java smoke test and one Kotlin smoke test, and both execute during `./gradlew build`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Test infrastructure
design_items.statement: The root `./gradlew build` SHALL pass on the local JDK 17 without an Android SDK.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Test infrastructure
design_items.statement: `gradle.properties` SHALL set `kotlin.stdlib.default.dependency=false`, so applying the Kotlin Gradle Plugin adds `kotlin-stdlib` to no main configuration.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Test infrastructure
design_items.statement: A build check SHALL fail when any module other than the Kotlin extension module has `kotlin-stdlib` on its `runtimeClasspath`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Nullability and API 21 checks
design_items.statement: Wave 1 SHALL add a nullability annotation library that the Kotlin compiler recognises, in `compileOnly` scope with no runtime dependency, chosen in #1.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Nullability and API 21 checks
design_items.statement: animal-sniffer with the `android-api-level-21` signature SHALL run on the main source set of `NaruServe-api`, the TinyHttpd adapter module, the Gson module, the bootstrap module, the Kotlin extension module, the Logcat `Logger` module and the rotating file `Logger` module as part of `check`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Nullability and API 21 checks
design_items.statement: The animal-sniffer API 21 check MUST NOT be applied to `NaruServe-servlet`, which is JVM-only.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Wave 1 documentation
design_items.statement: `docs/api/README.md`, `docs/api/app.md`, `docs/api/json.md`, `docs/api/kotlin.md` and `docs/api/logging.md` SHALL name the final module names and dependency coordinates fixed in #1, so wave 1 removes every (미확정) module-name marker in `docs/api/`.

design_items.heading_path: 1. Build foundation / Wave 1 documentation
design_items.statement: Wave 1 SHALL update the module line of `CLAUDE.md` to list every module fixed in #1, mark the modules under the animal-sniffer API 21 check of D-027 as API 21 check targets and keep `NaruServe-servlet` marked JVM-only.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: New D-448: wave 1 updates the CLAUDE.md module line with the module set and the API 21 check targets of D-027.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Method enum
design_items.statement: `Method` SHALL be a Java enum with exactly the constants `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS`, `TRACE`, `CONNECT`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Method enum
design_items.statement: `Method` SHALL provide the static factories `get()`, `any()` and `of(Method...)`, each returning a `MethodSet`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Method enum
design_items.statement: `Method` MUST NOT expose instance methods named after HTTP methods, so `Method.GET.delete()` does not compile.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: `MethodSet` SHALL be immutable, with every combinator returning a new instance and leaving the receiver unchanged (T01).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: `MethodSet` SHALL provide `get()`, `head()`, `post()`, `put()`, `patch()`, `delete()` and `options()`, each returning a new set with that method added (T01).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: `MethodSet.except(Method)` SHALL return a new set without the given method (T02).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: `Method.any()` SHALL contain exactly `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` and `OPTIONS`, leaving out `TRACE` and `CONNECT`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: `Method.any().except(Method.DELETE)` SHALL equal the set of `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `OPTIONS` (T02).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: `MethodSet` SHALL expose membership and an iteration in enum declaration order through accessors whose names are decided in #2.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / MethodSet
design_items.statement: Two `MethodSet` values with the same members SHALL be equal and have equal hash codes.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: A route pattern SHALL consist of literal segments and `:name` variable segments, where a variable matches exactly one non-empty path segment and never crosses `/`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: Registering a pattern that contains Express wildcard or regular-expression syntax (`?`, `*`, `+`, parentheses) SHALL fail with a configuration error.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: The router SHALL ignore the query string when matching.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: Matching SHALL be case-sensitive and trailing-slash-sensitive by default, so `/Users` and `/users/` do not match `/users`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: The request path SHALL be percent-decoded exactly once before matching, so `%252e` reaches the router as the literal text `%2e`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: A request path with malformed percent-encoding, invalid UTF-8, raw non-ASCII bytes, an encoded `/`, an encoded or raw `NUL`, or any `.` or `..` segment in raw or encoded form SHALL be rejected with `400` before routing on every adapter, matching the rules TinyHttpd's parser applies before NaruServe sees the request.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Path patterns and URL decoding
design_items.statement: The router SHALL support switching the handling of `//`, trailing slashes and case away from the strict default through a router option, which wave 3 exposes on `RestApp` under a name decided in #3.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Priority and conflicts
design_items.statement: A literal segment SHALL win over a variable segment at the same position regardless of registration order (T04).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Priority and conflicts
design_items.statement: Pattern priority SHALL be compared segment by segment from the left, with the first differing segment deciding.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Priority and conflicts
design_items.statement: Registering the same method and pattern twice SHALL be reported as a configuration error when the route table is frozen, which `listen()` triggers before binding (T03).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Priority and conflicts
design_items.statement: Two patterns that differ only in variable names and share a method SHALL be reported as a configuration error when the route table is frozen.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Priority and conflicts
design_items.statement: A routing configuration error SHALL name both conflicting registrations and be raised by the route-table freeze that wave 4 runs inside `listen()` before any socket is bound.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Priority and conflicts
design_items.statement: The router SHALL be engine-free code inside `NaruServe-api`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router contract
design_items.statement: The router SHALL store each registration with an opaque handler type parameter, so wave 2 compiles and tests without `Request`, `Response`, `RouteHandler` or `RestApp`.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router contract
design_items.statement: A route lookup SHALL return an engine-free match result that is exactly one of matched (handler, path parameters, actual method, automatic-`HEAD` flag), method mismatch, automatic OPTIONS, WebSocket-only, unsupported method or no match.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: For a path that matches no route the router SHALL return the no-match result (T06).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: For a path that matches but has no registration for the request method, the router SHALL return the method-mismatch result carrying every method the path accepts, including automatic `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` (T02, T06).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: For a `HEAD` request to a path with only a `GET` registration, the router SHALL return the `GET` registration marked as automatic `HEAD` (T05).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: An explicit `HEAD` registration SHALL take precedence over automatic `HEAD` resolution in the router.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: For an `OPTIONS` request to a path without an explicit `OPTIONS` registration, the router SHALL return the automatic-OPTIONS result carrying the accepted methods (T05).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: An explicit `OPTIONS` registration SHALL take precedence over the automatic-OPTIONS result.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: A request whose method token is not one of the `Method` constants SHALL yield the unsupported-method result from the router (T06).

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Router results for automatic responses
design_items.statement: `TRACE` and `CONNECT` SHALL yield the unsupported-method result and reach no route unless an explicit policy, whose semantics wave 2 decides, enables them, a policy that on the TinyHttpd adapter also governs a `CONNECT` with an origin-form or absolute-form target, because TinyHttpd's parser answers `501` before dispatch only for a `CONNECT` with an authority-form target, which is recorded as a deferred TinyHttpd gap under D-020.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / WebSocket routes in the router
design_items.statement: The router SHALL resolve a `GET` request carrying `Upgrade: websocket` against WebSocket registrations separately from `GET` registrations, so a WebSocket route and a `GET` route coexist on one path.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / WebSocket routes in the router
design_items.statement: For a request without `Upgrade` to a path that has only WebSocket registrations, the router SHALL return the WebSocket-only result, which the wave 3 dispatcher answers with `426 Upgrade Required` carrying `Upgrade: websocket` and `Connection: Upgrade`, and wave 7 asserts end to end.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / WebSocket routes in the router
design_items.statement: An `Upgrade: websocket` request to a path with no WebSocket registration SHALL be resolved as an ordinary `GET` without upgrading, reaching that path's `GET` registration or else the method-mismatch or no-match result, as a router test asserts for a path with only a `GET` route and a path with no route.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / WebSocket routes in the router
design_items.statement: The router SHALL accept WebSocket registrations through an internal hook that marks a pattern as WebSocket, so wave 7 adds `app.ws` without changing the router.

design_items.heading_path: 2. Routing core / Wave 2 open items
design_items.statement: Wave 2 SHALL decide the (미확정) routing policy semantics owned by #3 (`//`, trailing-slash and case handling, the `TRACE`/`CONNECT` enable policy) and update `docs/api/routing.md`, removing those markers.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: New D-441: an Upgrade: websocket request to a path with no WebSocket registration is resolved as an ordinary GET without upgrading (GET route, else method mismatch or no match), with a router test.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Public surface ownership
design_items.statement: Wave 3 SHALL create the `Request` and `Response` interfaces holding the `docs/api/request.md` and `docs/api/response.md` methods whose parameter and return types exist by the end of wave 3, leaving every other method to the wave that owns its types (D-392).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Public surface ownership
design_items.statement: Every public method parameter and return value of reference type in `Request` and `Response` SHALL carry `@Nullable` or `@NonNull`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Public surface ownership
design_items.statement: The remaining `Request` and `Response` methods SHALL be added by their owning waves: `req.service` and `req.application` in wave 4, `req.body`, `res.json`, `req.cookie`, `req.getCookies` and `res.addCookie` in wave 5, `req.form`, `req.file`, `req.files`, `req.parts`, `res.file`, `res.download` and `res.cache` in wave 6, and `res.sse` in wave 7.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: `RestApp` SHALL provide `get`, `post`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, `head` and `options` taking `(String path, RouteHandler handler)` and returning `RestApp`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: `route(Method, path, handler)` and `route(MethodSet, path, handler)` SHALL register the one handler for every method in the argument and return `RestApp` (T01).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: A request dispatched to a handler registered for several methods SHALL report its actual method through `req.method()` (T01).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: `route(path)` SHALL return a `RouteBuilder` whose `get`, `post`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, `head` and `options` each register a separate handler on that path (T03).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: `app.get(path, h)` and `app.route(path).get(h)` SHALL produce the same registration, so registering both for one path is a duplicate (T03).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: `RouteHandler` SHALL be a `@FunctionalInterface` with the single method `void handle(Request req, Response res) throws Exception`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: `RestApp` MUST NOT expose a `serve(...)` registration method.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Route registration API
design_items.statement: Wave 3 SHALL create the `RestApp` interface with the route registration and routing policy methods, and each later wave adds the `RestApp` methods of its own features.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Dispatcher and automatic responses
design_items.statement: Wave 3 SHALL own the dispatcher, the single engine-free component in `NaruServe-api` that takes a request from an `HttpAdapter`, looks it up in the router and either calls the matched handler with `Request` and `Response` or writes the automatic response.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Dispatcher and automatic responses
design_items.statement: The dispatcher SHALL answer the no-match result with `404`, the method-mismatch result with `405` and an `Allow` header listing the accepted methods including automatic `HEAD` and `OPTIONS`, the automatic-OPTIONS result with `204` and `Allow`, the unsupported-method result with `501` and the WebSocket-only result with `426` plus the headers `Upgrade: websocket` and `Connection: Upgrade` required by RFC 9110 section 15.5.22 (T02, T05, T06).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Dispatcher and automatic responses
design_items.statement: For an automatic-`HEAD` result the dispatcher SHALL run the `GET` handler and send its status and headers without a body under D-102 (T05).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Dispatcher and automatic responses
design_items.statement: The dispatcher SHALL answer the asterisk-form request `OPTIONS *`, whose raw path TinyHttpd passes as `*`, with `204` and an `Allow` header listing the methods of `Method.any()` (D-036) without route lookup or the path rejection of D-052, and answer any other raw path that does not start with `/` with `400`, identically on the in-memory and TinyHttpd adapters.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Dispatcher and automatic responses
design_items.statement: The HTTP-level assertions of T01, T02, T03, T05 and T06 SHALL run through the in-memory adapter in wave 3.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.path()` SHALL return the decoded path without the query string.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.rawPath()` SHALL return the path as received before decoding, with the inclusion of the query string decided in #4.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.param(name)` for a name absent from the matched pattern SHALL throw an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.query(name)` SHALL return the first value for the name or `null`, and `req.queries(name)` returns every value in request order or an empty list (T07).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: Query names and values SHALL be decoded as UTF-8 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` text, with `+` read as a space (T07).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: A query string with malformed percent-encoding or invalid UTF-8 SHALL make the request fail with `400` (T07).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.header(name)` SHALL match names case-insensitively and return the first value or `null`, and `req.headers(name)` returns every value or an empty list (T07).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.remoteAddress()` and `req.isSecure()` SHALL ignore `X-Forwarded-*` and `Forwarded` headers unless proxy trust is configured through the API decided in #8.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.lastEventId()` SHALL return the `Last-Event-ID` header value or `null`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.attribute(key, value)` and `req.attribute(key, type)` SHALL store values per request, returning `null` for a missing key and never sharing values with another request.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: The request attribute store SHALL be safe for concurrent writes from several threads serving the same request.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Request accessors
design_items.statement: A mutating `Response` call (`status`, `header`, `addCookie`, `cache` or a body write) after the response completed SHALL throw an `IllegalStateException`, while the read accessors of `Request` and `Response`, `isCommitted()` and `abort()` stay usable after completion, including in middleware after `next.run()` returned and in `onError` (`docs/api/middleware.md`).

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Body ownership
design_items.statement: Each request SHALL track its body with an internal `BodyState` moving from `UNREAD` through `PARSING` to `CONSUMED` or `CLOSED`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Body ownership
design_items.statement: Any body read after the first one (JSON, form, multipart or raw), including a repeated `req.body(...)` call through the same JSON reader, SHALL throw `BodyAlreadyConsumedException`, an unchecked exception in `NaruServe-api`, with the shared parse of D-087 as the only exemption.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Body ownership
design_items.statement: Repeated calls of `form`, `file`, `files` and `parts` SHALL share one parse of the body.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Body ownership
design_items.statement: Body size limits SHALL be enforced on the incoming byte stream before and during parsing, including chunked bodies without `Content-Length`, with `413` when exceeded.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.status` and `res.header`, and `res.addCookie` and `res.cache` once waves 5 and 6 add them, SHALL return the same `Response` for chaining.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: A response SHALL default to status `200`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.send(String)` SHALL write UTF-8 text with `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8` unless a `Content-Type` was set explicitly.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.html(String)` SHALL write UTF-8 text with `Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.send(byte[])` SHALL write the bytes unchanged, with its default `Content-Type` decided in #4.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.stream(InputStream, contentType)` SHALL copy the stream to the end in bounded chunks, with closing of the stream decided in #4.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.end()` SHALL complete the response without a body.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.isCommitted()` SHALL return `true` once the status line and headers were handed to the transport.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.abort(error)` SHALL end the response abnormally by closing the connection and set the state to `ABORTED`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response API
design_items.statement: `res.header(name, value)` SHALL reject a name or value containing CR or LF with an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response state machine
design_items.statement: A response SHALL move through the states `NEW`, `COMMITTED`, `STREAMING`, `COMPLETED` and `ABORTED`, committing at most once.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response state machine
design_items.statement: Calling `status` or `header` after commit, and `addCookie` or `cache` after commit once they exist, SHALL throw an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response state machine
design_items.statement: Sending a second body after a body was sent SHALL throw an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response state machine
design_items.statement: Responses with status `204` or `304`, and every response to a `HEAD` request, SHALL be sent without a message body, discarding any body the handler supplied.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Response state machine
design_items.statement: A streaming response (`sse`, `file`, `download`, `stream`) SHALL stay in `STREAMING` after the handler returns until the transfer ends.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / HttpAdapter SPI
design_items.statement: The `HttpAdapter` SPI SHALL live in `NaruServe-api` and use only JDK and NaruServe types.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / HttpAdapter SPI
design_items.statement: The SPI SHALL give the core the request line, headers, a streaming body `InputStream`, remote address and secure flag, and accept status, headers and a streaming body `OutputStream`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / HttpAdapter SPI
design_items.statement: The SPI SHALL include extension points for file transfer, event streams and protocol upgrade, where the event-stream point hands the adapter a core-owned drain loop that keeps writing after the handler returned until the core reports the stream ended, and the adapter chooses the thread that runs that loop (the request worker on TinyHttpd, an `AsyncContext` on the Servlet adapter), so waves 6, 7 and 8 add adapter classes without changing the SPI.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / HttpAdapter SPI
design_items.statement: The SPI SHALL let the core bind to an address and port synchronously, read the actual bound port, and stop in two calls: a blocking stop that stops accepting, waits for in-flight exchanges until a deadline the core passes and then force-closes the remaining connections, and a final release that waits at most a fixed margin for the adapter's threads to end.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / HttpAdapter SPI
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-api` SHALL ship an in-memory `HttpAdapter` in a test fixtures source set that runs requests through the full core pipeline without sockets.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / HttpAdapter SPI
design_items.statement: Every adapter SHALL pass the raw request-target path and the raw query string through the SPI for the core to decode once, with the TinyHttpd adapter taking them from `getRequestURI()` and `getQueryString()` and never from the decoded, `//`-merging `getPath()`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Wave 3 open items
design_items.statement: Wave 3 SHALL decide the (미확정) items owned by #4 (query in `rawPath()`, default `Content-Type` of `send(byte[])`, stream closing in `stream()`, exception type for an attribute type mismatch) and update `docs/api/request.md` and `docs/api/response.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 3. Request and response core / Wave 3 open items
design_items.statement: Wave 3 SHALL decide the `RestApp` names of the routing policy APIs and the value of `req.method()` during automatic `HEAD`, and update `docs/api/routing.md` and `docs/api/app.md`, removing those markers.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: New D-442: OPTIONS * answered 204 with Allow = Method.any() methods without route lookup or D-052 rejection; any other raw path not starting with / gets 400; identical on in-memory and TinyHttpd adapters. I-021 now includes the OPTIONS * case.
Same fix as V1-006: D-442 fixes the dispatcher's answer to OPTIONS * on both adapters; I-021 covers it.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / RestApp assembly
design_items.statement: `RestApp.create()` SHALL be a static interface method that returns an app assembled by the bootstrap module (section 5).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / RestApp assembly
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-api` SHALL offer an explicit initialisation entry point that accepts an `HttpAdapter` and a `JsonCodec`, with its name and methods decided in #5.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / RestApp assembly
design_items.statement: Wave 4 SHALL create the `JsonCodec` SPI interface in `NaruServe-api` with the signatures of D-182, so the explicit entry point compiles, while wave 5 adds `TypeRef`, the JSON request and response methods and the Gson implementation.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / RestApp assembly
design_items.statement: `JsonCodec` SHALL declare `<T> T decode(Reader reader, Type type) throws IOException` and `void encode(Object value, Writer writer) throws IOException`, with no Gson type in its signatures.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / RestApp assembly
design_items.statement: Each `RestApp` instance SHALL own its configuration, registry and context, with no static state shared between instances.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / RestApp assembly
design_items.statement: Every registration and configuration method of `RestApp` (routes, `use`, `accessLog`, `logger(l)`, `onStart`, `onStop`, `onError`, and `ws`, `staticFiles`, `multipart` and `jsonCodec` once later waves add them) SHALL throw an `IllegalStateException` when the app state is not `NEW`, through one state guard that wave 4 provides and later waves call.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: `Middleware` SHALL be a `@FunctionalInterface` with `void handle(Request req, Response res, Next next) throws Exception`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: `Next` SHALL provide `run()` to continue the chain and `error(Throwable)` to pass an error to error handling.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: `app.use(mw)` SHALL apply the middleware to every request that reaches the dispatcher, including requests that end in `404` or `405`, with the static-file and WebSocket-upgrade cases asserted in waves 6 and 7 (T35).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: `app.use(prefix, mw)` SHALL apply the middleware to the prefix path and paths below it on a segment boundary, so `/api` covers `/api` and `/api/users` but not `/apix` (T35).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: Each route registration method SHALL have an overload that takes one route middleware before the handler, such as `app.get(path, mw, handler)` (T35).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: The pipeline SHALL run all global middleware in registration order, then all matching prefix middleware in registration order, then route middleware in registration order, then the handler (T35).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: A request with no explicit route SHALL reach the dispatcher's fallback point after global and prefix middleware ran, which answers `404` until wave 6 adds static mounts in front of it.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: A second `next.run()` call within one middleware invocation SHALL throw an exception (T35).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: Calling `next.run()` after the response completed or after the request ended SHALL throw an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: `next.run()` SHALL return only after every downstream middleware and the handler returned.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: A middleware that stops the chain by responding without calling `next.run()` SHALL have its response delivered with no later middleware or handler run (T36).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: When the chain returns with no response and no `next.run()`, the framework SHALL log a developer warning through the app logger and finish the request without waiting for a timeout, with the finishing behaviour decided in #5.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: An exception thrown from a middleware or handler, and an error passed to `next.error(e)`, SHALL reach the same error handling path (T36).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Middleware chain
design_items.statement: Middleware execution in v1 SHALL be synchronous, with no API for continuing the chain from another thread.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: `app.onError((error, req, res) -> ...)` SHALL receive every unhandled exception of a request that reached the dispatcher, including framework errors for `400`, `413` and `415`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: Framework-raised errors SHALL expose their HTTP status to `onError` through a mechanism decided in #5.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: When the response is already committed, the framework MUST NOT write an error body and aborts the connection instead (T37).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: Without a registered `onError`, an error of a request that reached the dispatcher SHALL be answered with the body `{"error":{"code":...,"message":...,"requestId":...}}` and `Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: Error responses MUST NOT contain stack traces or exception class names.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: The default status mapping SHALL be: parse failure `400`, validation failure `400` or an explicit `422`, unmatched path `404`, unmatched method `405`, size limit `413`, unsupported media type `415`, request arriving during `STOPPING` `503`, any other exception `500`, with transport-level `503` rejections left to D-400.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: The `requestId` field of a standard error body SHALL hold the same request identifier that the access log records for that request.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: An exception during `res.json` serialisation SHALL turn into an error response only while the response is uncommitted, asserted in wave 5 once `res.json` exists.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Error handling and standard error JSON
design_items.statement: Wave 4 SHALL decide the (미확정) items owned by #5 (entry point name and methods, multi-middleware overloads, `RouteBuilder.use(middleware)`, `onError` chaining, `code` values per status, custom `404`/`405` bodies, callback interface names and `throws Exception`) and update `docs/api/middleware.md`, `docs/api/app.md` and `docs/api/express-migration.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: `ServiceRegistry` SHALL provide `register(Class<T>, T)`, `get(Class<T>)`, `getOrNull(Class<T>)` and `contains(Class<?>)`, with `get` throwing `ServiceNotFoundException` for a missing type.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: `ctx.register` SHALL succeed only inside `onStart` callbacks while the app is `STARTING`, and throws otherwise (T42).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: Registering the same `Class` key twice SHALL fail with a configuration error without replacing the first instance (T42).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: The registry SHALL be frozen into an immutable snapshot before the app enters `RUNNING`, so request threads read it without locking.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: `req.service(T)` SHALL return the same instance as `req.application().get(T)`, which is the instance registered in `onStart`, for HTTP, WebSocket and SSE handlers alike (T41).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: Each `onStart` callback SHALL run exactly once per successful `listen()` (T41).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: `ApplicationContext.attribute` SHALL be readable and writable in every state from `STARTING` to `STOPPING` and safe for concurrent access.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: `ctx.logger()` SHALL return the same `Logger` as `app.logger()`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: There SHALL be exactly one `ApplicationContext` per `RestApp`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: `ctx.own(resource)` SHALL make the framework close the resource on shutdown and on start failure.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: An object owned or registered several times, including under an interface key and an implementation key, SHALL be closed exactly once, compared by identity (T45).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: Owned and registered `AutoCloseable` objects SHALL be closed in reverse order of their first `own` or `register` call (T43, T45).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: An exception from one `close()` SHALL be collected while the remaining resources are still closed.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / ServiceRegistry and ApplicationContext
design_items.statement: Wave 4 SHALL decide how an externally owned object is registered without automatic close (`registerExternal` or `Ownership.EXTERNAL` are the candidates) and update `docs/api/lifecycle.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `app.state()` SHALL return one of `NEW`, `STARTING`, `RUNNING`, `STOPPING`, `FAILED`, `TERMINATED`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `listen()` SHALL move the app from `NEW` to `STARTING` atomically, and a second or concurrent `listen()` throws an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `listen()` SHALL run `onStart` callbacks in registration order, then freeze and validate router, registry and options, then bind the socket and start accepting through the adapter in one call, then enter `RUNNING`, with requests accepted before `RUNNING` held by the start gate of D-428.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `listen()` SHALL return only after binding succeeded, giving a `ServerHandle` that reports the actual port, address and state through accessors named in #6.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: No request SHALL be dispatched to the pipeline before the app is `RUNNING`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: The dispatcher SHALL hold every request that reaches it before the app is `RUNNING` on a start gate, releasing it into the pipeline once `RUNNING` is set and answering it with `503` and `Connection: close` when the start fails or a pending stop of D-426 ends it, because TinyHttpd's `start()` binds and starts its acceptor in one call with no hook in between.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: When `onStart`, validation or binding fails, no listening socket SHALL remain open after `listen()` throws (T43).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: On start failure, already owned and registered resources SHALL be closed in reverse order before `listen()` throws (T43).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: On start failure the state SHALL pass through `FAILED` to `TERMINATED`, and `listen()` throws the cause, wrapping a checked cause in an unchecked exception whose type is decided in #6.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `onStop` MUST NOT run for an app that never reached `RUNNING`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: The first `shutdown(timeout, unit)` call SHALL move a `RUNNING` app to `STOPPING` atomically, and later calls return without side effects (T46).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: Shutdown SHALL compute one deadline from the timeout and run in order: the before-wait participants, the adapter stop of D-107 up to that deadline (stop accepting, wait for in-flight requests, force-close what remains), the force-close participants, `onStop` once while services are still registered, the after-`onStop` participants, closing owned resources in reverse order, flushing and closing log writers, the adapter release of D-107 and the move to `TERMINATED`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: Wave 4 SHALL provide an internal shutdown participant registry with the fixed phases of the D-162 sequence (before-wait participants running before the adapter stop, force-close participants running after the adapter stop returned, and after-`onStop` participants), into which wave 6 adds temporary-file cleanup (D-255) as an after-`onStop` participant, so spool files of uploads still in flight during the adapter stop stay intact, and wave 7 adds WebSocket closing (D-435) and SSE closing (D-436) as before-wait participants, without editing the sequence.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `onStop` callbacks SHALL be able to read every registered service (T45).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `shutdown` on an app in `NEW` SHALL move it to `TERMINATED` without running `onStart` or `onStop`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: A `shutdown` call while the app is `STARTING` SHALL record a pending stop and wait up to its timeout for `listen()` to end, and `listen()` then finishes the step in progress, closes any bound socket, never enters `RUNNING`, never runs `onStop`, closes owned and registered resources in reverse order, passes through `FAILED` to `TERMINATED` as D-159 and the object.md §11.3 failure path require and throws an exception whose type #6 decides, as a test that runs `listen()` with an `onStart` blocked on a latch and calls `shutdown` from another thread asserts (T46).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: A `shutdown` call on an app in `FAILED` SHALL wait up to its timeout until the failing `listen()` reached `TERMINATED` and return, while a call on a `TERMINATED` app returns at once with no side effects.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: When the timeout of a `shutdown` call made during `STARTING` passes before `listen()` ended, for example with `onStart` still blocked, `shutdown` SHALL return normally without an exception, leaving `state()` at `STARTING` or `FAILED` and the pending stop of D-426 in force, so the blocked `listen()` still passes through `FAILED` to `TERMINATED` and throws once `onStart` returns, with `docs/api/lifecycle.md` recording this result and the T46 test of D-426 asserting it with a `shutdown` timeout shorter than the latch release.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: `listen()` on a `TERMINATED` app SHALL throw an exception (T46).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: A request that reaches the dispatcher after `STOPPING` began SHALL receive `503` with `Connection: close`, while once the adapter stop of D-162 has begun TinyHttpd closes an idle keep-alive connection without processing a request that races the close and commits in-flight responses with `Connection: close`, so the T44 test of this item accepts for a request sent on a keep-alive connection after `STOPPING` began either a `503` with `Connection: close` or a connection closed without a response.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Lifecycle state machine
design_items.statement: Wave 4 SHALL decide whether server threads keep the JVM alive after `main` returns and document it in `docs/api/app.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: `Logger` SHALL provide `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error(String)` and `error(String, Throwable)`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-api` SHALL ship a console `Logger` that is the default of the explicit entry point and of `RestApp.create()` on the JVM.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: The Logcat `Logger` SHALL map each level to the matching `android.util.Log` method looked up by reflection, verified by a JVM test against a test-scope fake `android.util.Log` class, with the log tag decided in #7.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: `app.logger(l)` SHALL replace the app logger, and `app.logger()` returns the current one.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: An exception thrown by a `Logger` or log writer MUST NOT interrupt request processing or server operation.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: `app.accessLog(options -> ...)` SHALL support `enabled`, `level`, `includeRequestId`, `includeDuration`, `includeBytes` and `exclude(path)`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: The access log SHALL write exactly one line per HTTP request that reached the dispatcher, when the response completes or is aborted, holding method, path, status, and, when enabled, latency, bytes and request id (T38).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: Requests to a path passed to `exclude` SHALL produce no access log line.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: The access log MUST NOT record `Authorization` or `Cookie` header values, passwords, tokens, request or response bodies, multipart content, or the query string (T39).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: CR, LF and other control characters in logged values SHALL be escaped (T39).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: Access log byte fields SHALL report body bytes actually read from and written to the connection, as documented in `docs/api/logging.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-api` MUST NOT depend on SLF4J or `android.*` (T40).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: The SLF4J adapter and the rotating file logger SHALL live in the optional modules that wave 1 declares outside `NaruServe-api` (T40).

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: The rotating file logger SHALL use a bounded queue with a drop counter and default to a `./logs` directory, 5 MiB per file and 5 files.

design_items.heading_path: 4. App assembly, middleware, lifecycle, logging / Logging SPI and access log
design_items.statement: Wave 4 SHALL decide the access log line format, the option defaults and the Logcat tag, and update `docs/api/logging.md`.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: D-166 now limits the 503 + Connection: close guarantee to requests that reach the dispatcher; once the adapter stop begins, TinyHttpd may close idle keep-alive connections unanswered (Connection.onServerStopping/closeIdle/lingerClose, persistentAtCommit isStopping), and the T44 test accepts either outcome.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JsonCodec and TypeRef
design_items.statement: `TypeRef<T>` SHALL capture the generic `java.lang.reflect.Type` of its anonymous subclass, so `new TypeRef<List<User>>() {}` yields `List<User>` (T08).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JsonCodec and TypeRef
design_items.statement: Constructing a `TypeRef` without a concrete type argument SHALL throw an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JsonCodec and TypeRef
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-api` SHALL ship consumer R8/ProGuard rules under `META-INF/proguard/` that keep the `Signature`, `InnerClasses` and `EnclosingMethod` attributes and keep `TypeRef` and every class extending it with `allowobfuscation` and `allowshrinking`, so a `TypeRef` subclass keeps its generic type argument in a minified Android build.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JsonCodec and TypeRef
design_items.statement: `app.jsonCodec(codec)` SHALL replace the codec used by `req.body`, `res.json`, `ws.sendJson` and `ws.onJson`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: `req.body(Class)` and `req.body(TypeRef)` SHALL parse only bodies whose `Content-Type` is `application/json` or an allowed `+json` type, and answer `415` otherwise (T09).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: A syntactically invalid JSON body SHALL produce `400` with code `BAD_REQUEST` (T09).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: A JSON body larger than the limit (default 1 MiB) SHALL produce `413` without being fully read into memory (T09).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: A JSON body nested deeper than the limit (default 64) SHALL produce `400` when decoded with the default codec (T09).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: A JSON body with invalid UTF-8 SHALL produce `400`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: Decoding MUST NOT instantiate classes named inside the JSON input.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: `req.body(Class)` and `req.body(TypeRef)` SHALL return `null` for a JSON `null` body and carry `@Nullable` on their return value, as the T08 round trip of D-194 requires.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: When wave 5 applies D-431, it SHALL rewrite every Kotlin example in `docs/api/` that assigns the result of `req.body(Class)` or `req.body(TypeRef)` to a non-null type, dereferences it or passes it on to a non-null parameter (in `kotlin.md` the `val users: List<User>` example and the `val body = req.body(CreateUserRequest::class.java)` example followed by `body.name`, in `README.md` the `val user = req.body(User::class.java)` example and in `express-migration.md` the `val todo = req.body(Todo::class.java)` example, both passed to a service call) to use a nullable type with safe-call syntax or the reified extension of D-354, make the extension body shown there compile under the JSON `null` decision of D-192, and set the `req.body(type)` row of the nullability table to `T?`, so the Kotlin tests of D-349 and D-351 compile.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON request bodies
design_items.statement: Wave 5 SHALL decide the JSON size and depth configuration API, whether `jsonTree()`/`jsonMap()` exist, and the handling of a JSON `null` body by the Kotlin reified extension of D-354, and update `docs/api/json.md`, `docs/api/request.md`, `docs/api/kotlin.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON responses
design_items.statement: `res.json(value)` SHALL encode through the configured codec with `Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON responses
design_items.statement: POJOs, `List<User>`, strings, numbers, booleans and `null` SHALL round-trip through `req.body` and `res.json` unchanged, while an untyped `Map` round-trips to JSON-value equality only, because the default Gson decodes its numbers as `Double` (`42` becomes `42.0`) as `docs/api/request.md` states (T08).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / JSON responses
design_items.statement: `res.json("hello")` SHALL send the body `"hello"` including the quotes, and `res.json(null)` sends `null`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Gson module
design_items.statement: `GsonJsonCodec` SHALL live in the Gson module and accept a caller-built `Gson` instance.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Gson module
design_items.statement: The default `Gson` SHALL be built with `Strictness.STRICT` and `disableJdkUnsafe()`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Gson module
design_items.statement: With the default codec, lenient JSON (comments, unquoted names, single quotes) SHALL be rejected with `400`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Gson module
design_items.statement: With the default codec, decoding into a class without a no-argument constructor SHALL fail instead of creating the instance through `Unsafe`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: `Cookie` SHALL be a NaruServe class in `NaruServe-api` with constructor `Cookie(String name, String value)` and a name that cannot change after construction.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: `Cookie` SHALL provide `getValue`/`setValue`, `getPath`/`setPath`, `getDomain`/`setDomain`, `getMaxAge`/`setMaxAge(int seconds)`, `getSecure`/`setSecure`, `isHttpOnly`/`setHttpOnly` and `getSameSite`/`setSameSite`, so Kotlin uses property syntax.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: `SameSite` SHALL be an enum with `STRICT`, `LAX` and `NONE`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: `res.addCookie` SHALL add one `Set-Cookie` header per call, serialising `Path`, `Domain`, `Max-Age` in seconds, `Secure`, `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Strict|Lax|None` when set (T33).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: A cookie with `maxAge` 0 SHALL serialise `Max-Age=0` with its path and domain, deleting the cookie in browsers (T33).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: A cookie name or value containing CR, LF, `;` or another character outside the RFC 6265 cookie grammar SHALL be rejected with an exception when it is set.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: `req.cookie(name)` SHALL return the first matching request cookie or `null`, and `req.getCookies()` returns an empty array when the request has none (T34).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: Cookies parsed from a request SHALL carry only name and value, with every response-only attribute left at its unset default (T34).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Cookie and SameSite
design_items.statement: Wave 5 SHALL decide the default and negative meaning of `maxAge`, `Expires` support and signed cookies, and update `docs/api/cookie.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd adapter SHALL implement the `HttpAdapter` SPI with TinyHttpd types confined to the adapter module.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL be split into per-feature classes, so waves 6 and 7 add classes for file transfer, event streams and upgrades without editing the adapter core, while every TinyHttpd builder limit stays mapped in the adapter core by wave 5 (D-404).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL bind to `InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress()` by default, passing it to TinyHttpd explicitly because TinyHttpd binds all interfaces when none is given (T49).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: Binding to `0.0.0.0` or another non-loopback address SHALL require an explicit configuration call whose name is decided in #8 (T49).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: `listen()` with a non-loopback bind address SHALL log a security warning through the app logger (T49).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL configure TinyHttpd's Host allowlist so requests addressed to the configured bind address are accepted.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The v1 TinyHttpd adapter MUST NOT configure a TinyHttpd TLS listener, so `req.isSecure()` on it returns `true` only through the proxy trust of D-080, with TLS/WSS recorded as a post-v1 item under D-434.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL configure TinyHttpd with `maxHeaderBytes` 16384 (16 KiB) answered with `431` and `maxRequestLineBytes` 8190 answered with `414`, a limit that counts the whole request line (method, target and version) and keeps TinyHttpd's default `inputBufferBytes` of 8192, because TinyHttpd's builder rejects an `inputBufferBytes` below `maxRequestLineBytes + 2` (T48).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The request-line configuration API of D-225 SHALL set TinyHttpd's `inputBufferBytes` to the larger of 8192 and the configured request-line limit plus 2, so every accepted value passes TinyHttpd's builder validation.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: One request header line SHALL be limited to `inputBufferBytes - 2` bytes (8190 by default, more only when D-414 raises `inputBufferBytes`) and answered with TinyHttpd's transport-level `431` of D-400 beyond it, because TinyHttpd's `RequestParser.parseHeaders` reads each header line with that cap apart from the `maxHeaderBytes` total of D-215, with `docs/api/defaults.md` recording this per-line limit beside the header-size total and the header-size API of D-225 stating that it leaves the per-line limit unchanged.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL keep TinyHttpd's header-count limit, header timeout and body-read timeout enabled and turn on the slow-body guard of D-413, closing header and body slowloris connections (T48).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL set TinyHttpd's `minRequestBodyRate` to a default of 240 bytes per second, so a request body arriving slower than that after TinyHttpd's 5 s body-wait grace fails, is answered `408` with `Connection: close` and closes the connection, and a T48 test drip-feeds a body and asserts the `408` and the close.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: Requests with conflicting `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding` SHALL be rejected with `400` by the TinyHttpd parser, verified by a NaruServe test (T48).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL use TinyHttpd's bounded worker pool, and a connection that cannot enter the full wait queue receives TinyHttpd's plain socket-level `503` under D-400.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL map TinyHttpd body exceptions to `413` for size overruns, `408` with `Connection: close` for every `SocketTimeoutException` while reading the request body (the slow-body guard of D-413 and the body-read timeout kept by D-216), and `400` for truncated or malformed bodies.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd adapter SHALL leave TinyHttpd's `maxRequestBodyBytes` at its default of `-1`, so no plain-text `413` is sent before dispatch and the core's per-type body limits of D-088 and D-188, and the form and multipart limits added in wave 6, answer `413` through `onError`, the standard error JSON and the access log, while TinyHttpd's `maxDrainBytes` (default 64 KiB) bounds the body bytes that no handler reads.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The adapter SHALL route TinyHttpd internal logging to the app `Logger`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: Requests that TinyHttpd rejects before dispatch with its fixed plain-text responses (`400` for an invalid request line, target, path, `Host` or framing including conflicting `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding`, `408` for the header timeout, `414`, `417`, `431`, `501` for a `CONNECT` with an authority-form target and for unknown transfer codings, `505` for an unsupported HTTP version, and the socket-level `503`) SHALL bypass `onError`, the standard error JSON and the access log, and `docs/api/defaults.md` lists them as transport-level rejections.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: A TinyHttpd adapter test SHALL send `CONNECT / HTTP/1.1` and assert the dispatcher's unsupported-method `501` with an access-log line, and send `CONNECT example.com:443 HTTP/1.1` and assert TinyHttpd's transport-level `501` with no access-log line.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd adapter SHALL install a TinyHttpd `ErrorHandler` that renders every error TinyHttpd raises after parsing and outside any NaruServe dispatch, such as the `Host` rejection of D-418, as the standard error body of D-132 with a fresh request id.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: A request whose `Host` fails TinyHttpd's allowlist of D-214 SHALL receive `421` rendered by the `ErrorHandler` of D-405 as the standard error body, bypassing `onError` and the access log, with the allowed host names set through the LAN binding API of D-225, as a TinyHttpd adapter test asserts and `docs/api/defaults.md` records.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd adapter core SHALL map the NaruServe connection limits onto TinyHttpd's builder with these bounded defaults: HTTP worker budget 64 and SSE stream limit 128, which together set `maxWorkers` to 192; `maxConnections` 512, which bounds open plus queued ordinary connections, excludes upgraded WebSocket connections and so leaves a wait queue of `maxConnections - maxWorkers` = 320; `maxUpgradedConnections` 128, which bounds WebSocket connections on their own, so open connections total at most 640; and `maxConnectionsPerAddress` 256 over every open connection from one address, so the T26 load from one loopback address fits the defaults.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: Freezing the configuration in `listen()` SHALL fail with a configuration error, before TinyHttpd's builder runs, when `maxConnections` is below the HTTP worker budget plus the SSE stream limit, and the wait-queue length is derived as `maxConnections - maxWorkers` instead of being configured on its own.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: `listen(0)` SHALL bind an ephemeral port that `ServerHandle` reports.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: A bind failure in the adapter SHALL make `listen()` throw with no socket left open.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: `shutdown(timeout, unit)` SHALL implement the adapter stop of D-107 with TinyHttpd's `stop(grace)`, passing the time left until the shared deadline of D-162 as grace, and the adapter release with `awaitTermination` bounded by the fixed margin of D-107.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: T07 SHALL run against the TinyHttpd adapter over real sockets as well as against the in-memory adapter.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / TinyHttpd adapter
design_items.statement: Wave 5 SHALL decide the LAN binding API including the allowed host names of D-418, the proxy trust API, and the configuration APIs for header size, header count, request-line length (D-414), timeouts, the minimum request body rate of D-413 and the connection limits of D-404 with the derived wait-queue length of D-415, and confirm `431`/`414`, updating `docs/api/app.md`, `docs/api/defaults.md` (naming the limit request-line length instead of URL length) and `docs/api/request.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Bootstrap and RestApp.create()
design_items.statement: `RestApp.create()` SHALL locate the bootstrap factory at runtime (ServiceLoader or a fixed class name), so `NaruServe-api` has no compile-time reference to TinyHttpd or Gson.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Bootstrap and RestApp.create()
design_items.statement: `RestApp.create()` without the bootstrap module on the classpath SHALL throw an exception whose message names the missing module.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Bootstrap and RestApp.create()
design_items.statement: The bootstrap module SHALL assemble the TinyHttpd adapter with a `GsonJsonCodec` built from the default `Gson` configuration.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Bootstrap and RestApp.create()
design_items.statement: The bootstrap module SHALL ship consumer R8/ProGuard keep rules that keep the factory found by `RestApp.create()`.

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Bootstrap and RestApp.create()
design_items.statement: `RestApp.create()` SHALL make the Logcat `Logger` the default app logger when `android.util.Log` is present at runtime, and the console `Logger` otherwise (`docs/api/logging.md`).

design_items.heading_path: 5. Engine adapter, JSON, cookies / Bootstrap and RestApp.create()
design_items.statement: Wave 5 SHALL verify that `docs/api/README.md`, `docs/api/app.md` and `docs/api/json.md` name the bootstrap and Gson modules exactly as wave 1 fixed them.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: New D-443: the TinyHttpd adapter leaves maxRequestBodyBytes at -1 so no pre-dispatch plain-text 413 exists; core per-type limits answer 413 through onError/error JSON/access log, and maxDrainBytes bounds unread bodies. D-400 stays unchanged since no pre-dispatch 413 is configured.
D-440 extended to every docs/api Kotlin example using req.body(...), naming the README.md and express-migration.md examples passed to service calls.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: `app.multipart(config -> ...)` SHALL accept `maxFileSize`, `maxRequestSize`, `maxParts`, `memoryThreshold` and `tempDirectory`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: Multipart defaults SHALL be 32 MiB per file, 64 MiB per request, 20 parts and a 64 KiB memory threshold.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: Exceeding the file size, request size or part count limit SHALL produce `413` (T15).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: Multipart size limits SHALL be checked on accumulated received bytes, also for chunked bodies and bodies without `Content-Length` (T15).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: The multipart parser SHALL limit the length of part header lines and the total part header size.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: A multipart body without a boundary parameter, or with a malformed boundary, SHALL produce `400`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: A nested `multipart/*` part SHALL be exposed as an ordinary part without recursive parsing.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
design_items.statement: An `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` body SHALL be read under a bounded size limit with a default of 1 MiB, configurable through an API whose name wave 6 decides and records with the default in `docs/api/request.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`, and produce `413` beyond it.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart configuration and limits
