design_items.statement: Wave 6 SHALL decide the default `tempDirectory`, the element type of `parts()` and whether it includes text fields, whether unlimited limits are allowed, and the in-memory limit of `UploadFile.bytes()`, and update `docs/api/multipart.md`, `docs/api/request.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.form(name)` SHALL return the first text field from a urlencoded or multipart body, or `null`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart request accessors
design_items.statement: `req.file(name)` SHALL return the first file part of that name or `null`, and `req.files(name)` returns all of them in order or an empty list (T13).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Multipart request accessors
design_items.statement: A request mixing text fields and several files SHALL expose all of them through `form`, `file`, `files` and `parts` (T13).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Spooling and filename safety
design_items.statement: File part bytes up to `memoryThreshold` SHALL stay in memory, and larger parts are spooled to a temporary file in the temp directory (T14).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Spooling and filename safety
design_items.statement: Uploading a file many times larger than `memoryThreshold` SHALL keep heap growth below a bound asserted by the test (T14).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Spooling and filename safety
design_items.statement: Temporary file names SHALL be generated by the server and never derived from client input (T16).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Spooling and filename safety
design_items.statement: `UploadFile.filename()` SHALL return the client value unchanged, and the framework never uses it to build a path (T16).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Spooling and filename safety
design_items.statement: The core's engine-free multipart parser SHALL serve every adapter, including the TinyHttpd adapter, which leaves TinyHttpd's `MultipartReader` unused, so T13–T17 exercise one parser.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / UploadFile
design_items.statement: `UploadFile` SHALL extend `AutoCloseable` and provide `name`, `filename`, `contentType`, `size`, `inputStream`, `save(File)`, `transferTo(OutputStream)` and `bytes`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / UploadFile
design_items.statement: `UploadFile.save(File)` SHALL write the full content to the destination and delete the temporary file after success.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / UploadFile
design_items.statement: `UploadFile.transferTo(OutputStream)` SHALL copy the full content into the target without closing it (T18).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / UploadFile
design_items.statement: `UploadFile.bytes()` SHALL throw an exception when the part exceeds the in-memory limit that D-239 fixes in `docs/api/multipart.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / UploadFile
design_items.statement: Using an `UploadFile` after its request ended SHALL throw an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / UploadFile
design_items.statement: `UploadFile` and its `java.io` methods MUST NOT expose `java.nio.file` types.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Temporary file cleanup
design_items.statement: Temporary upload files SHALL be deleted when the request ends, after a successful `save`, after a `413`, and when the client disconnects mid-upload (T15, T17).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Temporary file cleanup
design_items.statement: Temporary upload files still open at shutdown SHALL be deleted before `shutdown` returns, through an after-`onStop` participant that wave 6 adds to the shutdown participant registry of D-401, so the cleanup runs only after in-flight requests finished or were force-closed by the adapter stop.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: `app.staticFiles(prefix, dir)` SHALL map `prefix + relative path` to the file under `dir`, so `/` serves `index.html` and `/assets/app.js` serves `assets/app.js` (T27).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: A request for a directory path ending in `/` SHALL serve the configured index file of that directory (T27).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Several mounts with different prefixes SHALL coexist.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Explicit routes SHALL take precedence over static mounts for the same path (T27).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Global middleware SHALL run on requests that end in a static file, asserted in wave 6 (T35).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: A non-`GET`/`HEAD` request to a path served only by a static mount SHALL receive `405` with `Allow: GET, HEAD`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Static options SHALL support `index(name)` (default `index.html`), `directoryListing(boolean)` (default `false`), `spaFallback(boolean)` (default `false`), `cache(pattern, policy)` and `mime(ext, type)`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: A directory request without an index file SHALL receive `404` while directory listing is disabled.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: With `directoryListing(true)`, a directory request without an index file SHALL receive `200` with a `text/html; charset=UTF-8` listing of the directory's entries sorted by name, each name HTML-escaped in the text and percent-encoded in its link, leaving out entries whose name starts with `.` and symbolic links, and resolving the directory under the traversal and canonical-root rules of D-268 to D-271.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Static responses SHALL carry `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Static files SHALL be streamed in bounded chunks without loading the whole file into the heap.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Static mounts
design_items.statement: Static mounts, `res.file` and `res.download` SHALL read files through an engine-free `ResourceResolver` interface in `NaruServe-api` with `open`, `length`, `etag` and `modified`, whose built-in `java.io.File` resolver is the only v1 implementation, with the SAF resolver recorded as a post-v1 (P5) item under D-380.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / SPA fallback
design_items.statement: SPA fallback SHALL serve the index file only when no file exists for the path, no explicit or WebSocket route matches, and the `Accept` header contains `text/html` (T27).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / SPA fallback
design_items.statement: Requests under `/api/` and `/ws/` SHALL never receive SPA fallback content.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / SPA fallback
design_items.statement: Wave 6 SHALL decide the excluded-prefix configuration of SPA fallback and the handling of a directory request without a trailing slash, and update `docs/api/static.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: A static request whose decoded path contains `..` segments, an encoded `/`, or `NUL`, including double-encoded forms, SHALL be rejected with `400` and never serve a file outside the root (T29).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: The resolver SHALL compute the canonical root once per mount with `java.io.File.getCanonicalFile()` and compare each opened file's canonical path with it, rejecting paths that escape it, so a root reached through a symbolic link (such as `/sdcard`) still serves its files.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: Symbolic links below the canonical root SHALL be refused by default, even when they point inside the root, detected with `java.io` only by comparing each path component's canonical path with its parent's canonical path plus its name, because `java.nio.file` is unavailable on API 21 (T29).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: A static-file test SHALL mount a root directory reached through a symbolic link and assert that its regular files are served while a symbolic link inside it is refused.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: After opening a file for a static mount, `res.file` or `res.download`, the resolver SHALL recompute the opened file's canonical path and the symbolic-link component check of D-270 and, when either fails, close the stream and refuse the file as D-270 does, with `docs/api/static.md` recording that a `java.io`-only resolver cannot bind the check to the opened descriptor, so a component swapped for a symbolic link between the re-check and the read stays a residual TOCTOU limit, and a T29 test swaps a path component for a symbolic link through a test hook between the first check and the open and asserts that no file outside the root is served (object.md §9.3).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: A path with any segment starting with `.` SHALL receive `404` (T29).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Path traversal and hidden files
design_items.statement: Wave 6 SHALL decide the symbolic-link allow setting and update `docs/api/static.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / MIME registry
design_items.statement: MIME lookup SHALL use the mount's `options.mime`, then the app-wide `app.mimeTypes()` registry, then the built-in table, then `application/octet-stream` (T28).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / MIME registry
design_items.statement: The built-in MIME table SHALL contain exactly the entries listed in `docs/api/static.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / MIME registry
design_items.statement: Extension matching SHALL ignore case.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / MIME registry
design_items.statement: `text/*` types SHALL be sent with `charset=UTF-8`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / MIME registry
design_items.statement: `app.mimeTypes().register(ext, type)` SHALL return the registry for chaining and affect only that app.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / CachePolicy
design_items.statement: `CachePolicy` SHALL be an immutable value object whose `immutable()` returns a new policy with `immutable` appended.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / CachePolicy
design_items.statement: `noStore()`, `noCache()`, `privateFor(10, MINUTES)` and `publicFor(1, HOURS)` SHALL produce `no-store`, `no-cache`, `private, max-age=600` and `public, max-age=3600` (T32).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / CachePolicy
design_items.statement: `res.cache(policy)` SHALL set the `Cache-Control` header from the policy.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / CachePolicy
design_items.statement: `options.cache(pattern, policy)` SHALL apply the policy to static files whose path matches the pattern, so `**/*.html` with `noCache()` and `/assets/**` with `publicFor(365, DAYS).immutable()` both hold (T32).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / CachePolicy
design_items.statement: A server-wide default `Cache-Control` policy SHALL be configurable on the app through an API whose name and default wave 6 decides and records in `docs/api/static.md`, `docs/api/response.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`, applying to every response that sets no `Cache-Control` through `res.cache`, `res.header`, a matching `options.cache` pattern or a built-in header such as the SSE one of D-326, as object.md §9.4 states and a T32 test asserts on a JSON route and a static file.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / CachePolicy
design_items.statement: Wave 6 SHALL decide the cache pattern syntax details (base of the pattern, zero-segment `**`, precedence among matching patterns) and update `docs/api/static.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: Static, `res.file` and `res.download` responses SHALL carry `ETag`, `Last-Modified` from the modification time truncated to whole seconds, and `Accept-Ranges: bytes` (T30).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: An `If-None-Match` that matches the current `ETag` SHALL produce `304` without a body and take precedence over `If-Modified-Since` (T30).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: An `If-Modified-Since` not older than the file's modification time truncated to whole seconds SHALL produce `304` when no `If-None-Match` is present (T30).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: A `HEAD` request for a static file SHALL carry the same headers as `GET` without a body (T30).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: A single satisfiable byte range SHALL produce `206` with `Content-Range`, clipping an end beyond the file length (T31).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: A single range starting at or beyond the file length SHALL produce `416` with `Content-Range: bytes */<length>` (T31).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: A request with several ranges or a malformed `Range` header SHALL receive the full `200` response (T31).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: An `If-Range` value that differs from the current validator, or that is a weak `ETag`, SHALL produce the full `200` response (T31).

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: A combined Range and cache test (T30, T31) SHALL assert that a `206` response carries the same `ETag`, `Last-Modified` and `Cache-Control` as the full `200`, that a `Range` request whose `If-None-Match` matches the current `ETag` receives `304` without a body, and that a `Range` request with a matching strong `If-Range` receives `206`.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: Range, ETag and conditional evaluation SHALL be engine-free code in `NaruServe-api`, with the TinyHttpd adapter free to use zero-copy file transfer.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: `res.download(file, filename)` SHALL send `Content-Disposition: attachment` with the filename stripped of header-injection characters.

design_items.heading_path: 6. Multipart and static files / Conditional and Range requests
design_items.statement: Wave 6 SHALL decide the `Content-Disposition` behaviour of `res.file()` and update `docs/api/response.md`.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: Temp-file cleanup is an after-onStop participant: D-401 says so, D-162 lists the after-onStop participants after onStop, D-255 says cleanup runs only after in-flight requests finished or were force-closed.

New D-447: post-open canonical-path and symlink re-check, residual java.io TOCTOU limit recorded in static.md, and a T29 test that swaps a path component for a symlink via a test hook (object.md 9.3).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: `app.ws(path, handler)` SHALL take a functional handler `(req, ws) -> ...` and use the same pattern syntax as HTTP routes.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: The WebSocket handler SHALL run once per accepted upgrade, and the connection stays open after it returns.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: Global and prefix middleware SHALL run on the upgrade request before the handshake, and a middleware response rejects the upgrade (T22).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: For an upgrade request the dispatcher SHALL run the global and prefix middleware chain to completion, with every `next.run()` returned, and only then, when no middleware responded, hand the request to the upgrade extension point of D-106, whose TinyHttpd class calls `WebSocketHandler.handle` on the same worker thread, which sends `101` and then runs the connection's read loop on that thread.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: The access-log line of D-173 for an accepted upgrade request SHALL be the D-325 handshake line with status `101`, written in TinyHttpd's `WebSocketListener.onOpen`, which runs on the read thread after the `101` was written and before the first frame is read, while an upgrade rejected before `onOpen` gets its ordinary D-173 line with its rejection status.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: The TinyHttpd upgrade class SHALL catch every `HttpException` that `WebSocketHandler.handle` or the `res.upgrade` call inside it throws before the `101` is written (`400` for a malformed handshake, `426` with `Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13`, `403` for a refused `Origin` or a `null` listener, `413` when the upgrade request body exceeds `maxDrainBytes`, `503` with `Retry-After` when `maxUpgradedConnections` is reached) and answer it through the dispatcher's error handling of that request with the exception's status and its headers set on the response, the request's id in the standard error body of D-132 and the access-log line of D-430 with the rejection status, as a T19 test sending `Sec-WebSocket-Version: 12` asserts by checking the `426`, the `Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13` header and the access-log line.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: After the upgrade, HTTP middleware MUST NOT run per WebSocket message.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: A valid RFC 6455 handshake (`Upgrade`, `Connection`, `Sec-WebSocket-Key`, version 13) SHALL receive `101` with the correct `Sec-WebSocket-Accept` (T19).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: A malformed handshake SHALL be rejected without upgrading the connection (T19).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: An upgrade whose `Origin` is not on the configured allowlist SHALL be rejected with `403` before the handshake (T22).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: Upgrade requests arriving after `STOPPING` began SHALL be rejected without upgrading.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: RFC 6455 framing SHALL come from TinyHttpd's websocket module, with NaruServe adding no own frame codec.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: A request without `Upgrade` to a path that has only an `app.ws` route SHALL receive `426 Upgrade Required` with `Upgrade: websocket` and `Connection: Upgrade` in an end-to-end test over the TinyHttpd adapter.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket registration and upgrade
design_items.statement: Wave 7 SHALL decide the Origin allowlist API and its default when unset, and the handler timing relative to `101`, and update `docs/api/websocket.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: An unmasked client frame SHALL close the connection with a protocol error (T20).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: A text message with invalid UTF-8 SHALL close the connection with code 1007 (T20).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: A message larger than the message limit (default 1 MiB) SHALL close the connection with code 1009 (T20).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: Fragmented messages SHALL be reassembled before delivery, with the message limit applied to the reassembled size (T20).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: A control frame longer than 125 bytes or fragmented SHALL close the connection with a protocol error.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: A Ping from the client SHALL be answered with a Pong, and `ws.ping()` sends a Ping (T21).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket protocol enforcement
design_items.statement: `ws.close(code, reason)` SHALL perform the close handshake, after which `isOpen()` returns `false`.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: `WebSocketSession` SHALL provide `id`, `sendText`, `sendBinary`, `sendJson`, `ping`, `close()`, `close(code, reason)`, `isOpen`, `onText`, `onBinary`, `onJson`, `onClose`, `onError` and `attribute`, with listeners as `@FunctionalInterface` types.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: Session ids SHALL be unique among the sessions of one app.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: Session attributes SHALL be stored per connection in a concurrent map, separate from request attributes, and released when the connection closes (T21).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: `onClose` listeners SHALL run exactly once per connection with the close code and reason.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: `sendJson` and `onJson` SHALL encode and decode through the configured `JsonCodec`.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: Services read in the WebSocket handler through `req.service` SHALL be the instances registered in `onStart` (T21).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocketSession
design_items.statement: Wave 7 SHALL decide how an `onJson` parse failure is reported (error callback or close) and update `docs/api/websocket.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket send queue
design_items.statement: Each session SHALL own a bounded outbound queue (default 1 MiB) because TinyHttpd's `WebSocket` send is synchronous.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket send queue
design_items.statement: WebSocket outbound queues SHALL be drained by one app-wide sender executor whose thread limit equals the WebSocket connection limit of D-404 (default 128), running at most one write task per session at a time and never queueing one session's task behind another session's in-flight write, so a stalled session holds only its own sender thread until TinyHttpd's write timeout (default 30 s) aborts its socket, and idle sender threads end after a keep-alive time.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket send queue
design_items.statement: Messages from concurrent senders SHALL be sent whole and in queue-entry order, with no interleaved frames (T23).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket send queue
design_items.statement: A slow or stalled client MUST NOT delay sends to other sessions, as a T23 test with at least 20 stalled sessions, more than any fixed pool of 16, next to one healthy session asserts by receiving the healthy session's message within 1 s.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket send queue
design_items.statement: When the outbound queue overflows, the session SHALL apply the overflow policy decided in #13 (exception or close) and release its queue (T23).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket send queue
design_items.statement: A closed session SHALL leave no queue, thread or attribute behind (T23).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: The idle timeout, ping interval and handshake timeout of WebSocket connections SHALL be configurable through APIs and defaults decided in #13, with the ping interval and idle timeout mapped as D-423 and D-425 state and the maximum connection count taken from D-404.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: The WebSocket message size limit (default 1 MiB, D-306), the WebSocket outbound queue size (default 1 MiB, D-318) and the SSE outbound queue size (default 256 KiB, D-406) SHALL be configurable through APIs whose names wave 7 decides and records in `docs/api/websocket.md`, `docs/api/sse.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`, with the pong timeout fixed by D-424 instead of configured and the configured WebSocket message limit passed to both `WebSocketHandler.maxFramePayloadBytes` and `WebSocketHandler.maxMessageBytes`, so one unfragmented frame and a fragmented message meet the same limit, as a T20 test with a non-default limit asserts by sending a message above it once as one frame and once fragmented and expecting close 1009 both times.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: The WebSocket ping interval setting SHALL be passed to TinyHttpd's `WebSocketHandler.pingInterval`, whose read loop sends a Ping after one interval without an inbound frame and closes with 1001 after a second such interval, so NaruServe runs no ping scheduler of its own.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: The WebSocket pong timeout SHALL equal the ping interval in v1, because TinyHttpd's read loop treats any inbound frame as the answer and its `WebSocketListener` has no Pong callback, with `docs/api/websocket.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md` stating this fixed relationship, a separate pong timeout recorded as a deferred TinyHttpd gap under D-020, and a T21 test asserting that a silent client is closed with 1001 within two ping intervals plus 1 s.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: The WebSocket idle timeout SHALL be enforced by NaruServe's one scheduler thread, which detects a session that has neither received nor sent a text or binary message for that timeout, hands close 1001 to that session's sender slot of D-417 and schedules a check 1 s later that aborts the session's socket through the `UpgradedConnection` captured as D-435 states when the close task has not returned by then, so the scheduler thread never writes to a socket or waits on one session, because TinyHttpd counts Ping and Pong frames as activity and never idles out a peer that answers its pings.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: WebSocket upgrades SHALL count against the WebSocket connection limit of D-404, whose mapping onto TinyHttpd's `maxUpgradedConnections` wave 5 owns, and an upgrade beyond it is answered `503`.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / WebSocket limits and logging
design_items.statement: The WebSocket access log SHALL write one line at the `101` handshake and a separate line at close with close code and duration (T38).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: `res.sse()` SHALL commit status `200` with `Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=UTF-8` and `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform`, return an `SseClient` and put the response in `STREAMING` (T24).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: An SSE connection SHALL stay open after the handler returns until the client disconnects, the app closes it or shutdown runs (T25).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: `client.send(event, data)` SHALL write an `event:` line and the data as `data:` lines followed by a blank line (T24).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: Data containing CR, LF or CRLF SHALL be split into one `data:` line per line (T24).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: `SseEvent.event(name).id(...).data(...).retry(millis)` SHALL produce the `event`, `id`, `retry` and `data` fields in the order shown in `docs/api/sse.md` (T24).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: An SSE event name or id containing CR, LF or `NUL` SHALL be rejected with an exception.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: The framework SHALL send `: ping` comment heartbeats at an interval decided in #14 (T25).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: `SseClient.send` SHALL be safe to call from several threads, writing whole events in call order.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: `onClose` listeners SHALL run exactly once when the stream ends by client disconnect, error or shutdown (T25).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: On the TinyHttpd adapter, SSE SHALL be written as a chunked streaming body through TinyHttpd's `Response.setHeader`, `flushBuffer()` and `getOutputStream()` on the request's worker thread, never through `startEventStream()`, whose fixed `Cache-Control: no-cache` and separate `retry` block cannot meet D-326 and D-330.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: Each SSE connection SHALL own a NaruServe bounded outbound queue (default 256 KiB) that `SseClient.send` from any thread fills with whole serialised events and that the D-106 drain loop empties to the socket on the thread the adapter chose, sending heartbeats when idle, with the overflow policy decided in #14.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: Each open SSE stream on the TinyHttpd adapter SHALL hold exactly one TinyHttpd worker thread and count against a NaruServe counter in the event-stream adapter class, never TinyHttpd's `maxEventStreams`, bounded by the SSE stream limit of D-404 with `503` beyond it, so the SSE thread count never exceeds that limit and open streams never take the HTTP worker budget.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: `req.lastEventId()` SHALL return the `Last-Event-ID` sent by a reconnecting `EventSource` (T24).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: The SSE access log SHALL write one line when the stream ends, covering start time, duration, bytes and the closing cause (T38).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / SSE stream
design_items.statement: Wave 7 SHALL decide the heartbeat interval, data-only send and explicit close APIs and the queue overflow policy, using the SSE stream limit of D-404, and update `docs/api/sse.md` and `docs/api/defaults.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: Shutdown SHALL close every open WebSocket session with close code 1001 Going Away (T21, T44).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: Shutdown SHALL close every open SSE stream and run its `onClose` listeners (T44).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: In-flight short HTTP requests SHALL complete before `onStop` runs when they finish within the timeout (T44).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: WebSocket and SSE connections that do not close within the shutdown timeout SHALL be force-closed.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: A before-wait shutdown participant of D-401 SHALL stop the WebSocket sender executor from taking new messages, discard every session's queued messages, hand close 1001 to each open session's sender slot of D-417 as its last task, wait until every close task returned or until 1 s or the time left to the D-162 deadline passed, whichever comes first, and then abort through `UpgradedConnection.close()` the socket of every session whose close task has not returned, whatever the age of its earlier writes, where the TinyHttpd upgrade class captures that connection by passing `WebSocketHandler.handle` a `ResponseWrapper` whose `upgrade` keeps the returned connection, and the bound rests on that abort alone with no write tracking: closing the socket makes a blocked write throw, including TinyHttpd's read-loop Ping and Pong writes and a close frame blocked on a full receive window, which all hold the same write lock, so TinyHttpd's later stop callback `close(1001)` finds `closeSent` set or the socket closed and returns at once instead of waiting up to the write timeout on the stopping thread.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: A before-wait shutdown participant of D-401 SHALL, without waiting, append to every open SSE stream's outbound queue of D-406 a closing notice exempt from the queue limit, whose form wave 7 decides and records in `docs/api/sse.md` under D-339, and mark the stream ended, so its D-106 drain loop wakes, writes the queued events and the notice, ends the chunked body, runs the `onClose` listeners of D-334 once and returns its worker, because TinyHttpd's stop closes only its own event streams and upgraded connections and otherwise waits for a D-335 stream until the deadline, leaving the adapter stop to wait only for short HTTP exchanges and for streams stalled on a full socket, which TinyHttpd aborts at the deadline (D-343).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: Each closing participant of D-435 and D-436 SHALL first set a closed flag under the lock of the session or stream registry it closes and then take its snapshot of open sessions or streams, after which `res.sse()` returns a stream that is ended at once with the closing notice of D-436 and its `onClose` listeners run, and an upgrade that reaches the upgrade extension point is answered `503` with `Connection: close` before any `101` instead of being registered, while every session or stream registered before the flag is in the snapshot.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: The before-wait participants of D-435 and D-436 SHALL run while TinyHttpd still accepts new connections, for at most the 1 s close wait of D-435, with every request that reaches the dispatcher in that phase answered `503` with `Connection: close` under D-166 and every upgrade refused under D-445, which `docs/api/lifecycle.md` records as a deviation from object.md §11.4, whose step 2 stops accepting new connections and upgrades before the WebSocket and SSE goodbye of step 3.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: `shutdown(timeout, unit)` SHALL return within the timeout plus a fixed margin recorded in `docs/api/lifecycle.md` and used as the T44 tolerance, where the core and adapter waits share the one deadline of D-162 and the margin covers TinyHttpd's `stop(grace)` overrun of up to 1.5 s after the grace (an acceptor join of up to 1000 ms and a worker wait of up to 500 ms) plus the adapter release wait of D-107, with the WebSocket close wait of D-435 and the SSE closing of D-436 counted inside the deadline and T44 using `onStop` callbacks and owned resources that return at once.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: A T44 test SHALL open at least two WebSocket sessions whose clients stop reading while the server sends to them until their writes block, one healthy WebSocket session and one SSE stream, call `shutdown` with a short timeout and assert that it returns within the timeout plus the margin of D-344, that the healthy session receives close 1001, that the SSE client receives the closing notice of D-436 and that the stalled sessions' sockets are closed.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Shutdown with long connections
design_items.statement: After `shutdown` returns, no NaruServe or TinyHttpd thread of that app, no WebSocket or SSE queue and no temporary upload file SHALL remain (T44).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Load bounds
design_items.statement: A JVM test SHALL hold 100 or more concurrent WebSocket and SSE connections from the loopback address under the default limits of D-404 and assert that thread count and heap growth stay below bounds written in the test (T26).

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Load bounds
design_items.statement: The defaults of D-404 and D-417 SHALL bound the threads of one app to 451: 192 TinyHttpd request workers (64 HTTP plus 128 SSE), 128 WebSocket read threads kept by upgraded connections, 128 WebSocket sender threads, one NaruServe scheduler thread for WebSocket idle timeouts (D-425), and TinyHttpd's acceptor and watchdog threads, where the request workers and read threads take TinyHttpd's `workerStackBytes` of 256 KiB, the NaruServe sender and scheduler threads request 256 KiB explicitly and the acceptor and watchdog use the platform default stack, so 449 threads request 112.25 MiB of stack in total, with the thread total and that stack figure recorded in `docs/api/defaults.md` for API 21 devices and the thread total used as the T26 thread bound.

design_items.heading_path: 7. WebSocket, SSE, long-connection shutdown / Load bounds
design_items.statement: Device-specific tuning of long-connection limits for low-end Android SHALL be recorded as a manual follow-up in the release test results.

carried_loop_d_residual.resolution: D-419 passes the configured WebSocket message limit to both WebSocketHandler.maxFramePayloadBytes and maxMessageBytes, with a T20 test at a non-default limit (single frame and fragmented).

New D-444: the TinyHttpd upgrade class catches every pre-101 HttpException from WebSocketHandler.handle/res.upgrade (400, 426 + Sec-WebSocket-Version, 403, 413, 503 + Retry-After) and answers it through the dispatcher's error handling with the exception's headers, the request id and the D-430 access-log line; T19 test with version 12. D-405 narrowed to errors outside any NaruServe dispatch.

New D-445: each closing participant sets a closed flag under its registry lock before its snapshot; later res.sse() returns a stream ended at once with the closing notice, later upgrades get 503 + Connection: close before 101. New D-446: before-wait participants run while TinyHttpd still accepts connections (at most 1 s), requests answered 503 under D-166, recorded in lifecycle.md as a deviation from object.md 11.4 step 2/3 ordering.
Same fix as V1-004: D-419 maps the configured limit to both maxFramePayloadBytes and maxMessageBytes, with the T20 single-frame and fragmented case.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: An automated check SHALL verify that every public method of `NaruServe-api` has a nullability annotation on its reference-typed return value and parameters.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: Every Kotlin example in `docs/api/` SHALL exist as a Kotlin test that compiles and runs (T11).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: Kotlin lambdas SHALL be accepted by every callback parameter without a DSL, such as `app.get("/x") { req, res -> }` (T11).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: A Kotlin test SHALL use each nullable accessor of the `docs/api/kotlin.md` table with safe-call syntax and each non-null one without it (T11).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: Public API method names MUST NOT be Kotlin hard keywords (`in`, `is`, `object`, `fun`, `when`, `val`, `var`).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: Value objects such as `Cookie` SHALL follow `getX`/`setX`/`isX` naming so Kotlin property syntax (`cookie.maxAge = 60`, `res.isCommitted`) compiles.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: The Kotlin extension module SHALL provide `inline fun <reified T : Any> Request.body(): T`.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: A Kotlin test SHALL show that the default Gson codec cannot decode a data class without a no-argument constructor, matching `docs/api/json.md` (T11).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: The framework MUST NOT use `runBlocking` as an asynchronous adapter.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Kotlin compatibility
design_items.statement: Wave 8 SHALL verify that `docs/api/kotlin.md` names the Kotlin module exactly as wave 1 fixed it.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Servlet adapter
design_items.statement: `NaruServe-servlet` SHALL implement the `HttpAdapter` SPI on `javax.servlet` 3.1, with no `jakarta.servlet` module in v1.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Servlet adapter
design_items.statement: The Servlet adapter SHALL run the app's `onStart` when the container initialises it and `shutdown` when the container destroys it.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Servlet adapter
design_items.statement: Application code on the Servlet adapter SHALL use the same routes, middleware, `Request`, `Response` and `Cookie` types as on the embedded engine.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Servlet adapter
design_items.statement: SSE on the Servlet adapter SHALL run the D-106 drain loop under `AsyncContext`, releasing the container request thread after the handler returned.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Servlet adapter
design_items.statement: Servlet adapter tests SHALL run on an embedded javax Servlet 3.1 container added in test scope only.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Servlet adapter
design_items.statement: Wave 8 SHALL decide container registration and class names, path handling relative to context path and servlet mapping, multipart and WebSocket support, and update `docs/api/servlet.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The Android sample SHALL be a standalone Gradle build under `samples/android` with `minSdk 21`, Java and Kotlin sources, consuming the root build through `includeBuild`.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The CLAUDE.md exception for the per-project build files of `samples/android` SHALL be recorded by the wave that creates the sample.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: Automation SHALL build the sample in Debug and Release with R8 minify on and off (T12).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The fixed Gradle 8.14.3, AGP 8.x and JDK 17 combination SHALL be written to the CI documentation.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The sample `Service` SHALL call `listen` and `shutdown` on a worker thread, never on the main thread (T47).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The sample Debug build SHALL enable a StrictMode thread policy that detects network and disk access on the main thread (T47).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The sample SHALL include a check, run in the R8-minified Release build, that an `@SerializedName` model encodes and decodes to identical JSON and that a JSON array of that model decodes through `new TypeRef<List<Model>>() {}` into a `List` whose elements have the model type (T12).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The sample's Kotlin sources SHALL compile in Debug and Release and exercise a SAM-lambda route, a nullable accessor with safe-call syntax, a multipart upload, a WebSocket endpoint and `req.service` in the device run.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android sample build
design_items.statement: The Android sample SHALL take its logger from `RestApp.create()` and show NaruServe log lines in Logcat during the device run, confirming the default of D-402.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android device verification
design_items.statement: The run SHALL attempt an API 21 emulator or device run of the sample, and when none boots, write a manual verification checklist for T10, T12 runtime and T47.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android device verification
design_items.statement: T10, the runtime part of T12 and T47 MUST NOT be marked verified without recorded API 21 device or emulator evidence.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Android device verification
design_items.statement: The latest-Android regression run SHALL be recorded with the same automated-or-manual-pending status rule.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: The release build SHALL generate a CycloneDX SBOM covering every published module (T50).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: A dependency vulnerability scan SHALL run, and when network access is unavailable the scan is recorded as pending with the full dependency list (T50).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: Release SHALL be blocked while a High or Critical dependency vulnerability remains without a recorded exception (T50).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: A license report SHALL confirm that every shipped dependency is under a non-GPL license and list them in a third-party license file (T50).

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: The repository SHALL contain a README with installation coordinates and a quick start that matches `docs/api/README.md`.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: Every (미확정) marker still in `docs/api/` SHALL be either resolved or rewritten as an explicit post-v1 item with its reason.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: A release test results document SHALL list T01–T50 with automated, manual-pending or verified status and evidence links.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: The release documentation SHALL record the Java 8 runtime row of the platform matrix as pending when no Java 8 runtime ran, citing `--release 8` and animal-sniffer as compile-time evidence.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: The release documentation SHALL state how consumers obtain TinyHttpd, since the composite build gives no published POM dependency.

design_items.heading_path: 8. Kotlin, Servlet, Android, release / Release preparation
design_items.statement: The release documentation and `docs/api/defaults.md` SHALL record TLS/WSS on the TinyHttpd adapter as an explicit post-v1 item, citing as reasons that no sub-issue of epic #20 covers it and that object.md §14.3 and §20.3 require separate API 21 TLS provider and certificate testing, which Q-3 leaves to manual device runs.

integration_items.statement: animal-sniffer API 21 checks SHALL pass on every Android-targeted module in `./gradlew build`.
An automated check SHALL fail the build when `NaruServe-api` classes reference `android.*`, `javax.servlet.*`, `jakarta.servlet.*`, `com.google.gson.*`, `com.snoworca.tinyhttpd.*` or `kotlin.*`.
The public API of `NaruServe-api` MUST NOT expose `java.nio.file`, `CompletableFuture` or `java.net.http` types.
Every Android-targeted module SHALL be free of `javax.servlet` references.
Dependency resolution of every module and the Android sample SHALL select Gson 2.14.0 and no other Gson version.
The TinyHttpd checkout SHALL show no modified files at the end of the run.
Every public callback type SHALL be annotated `@FunctionalInterface`.
Every change to a public API SHALL update the matching `docs/api/` file in the same wave.
Every JVM Java example in `docs/api/` SHALL compile as part of the root test suite, and the Android-only examples compile in the `samples/android` build.
The Kotlin tests for T11 SHALL be updated whenever a public API changes.
The default values in `docs/api/defaults.md` SHALL equal the defaults in the configuration classes, checked by a test.
The path-rejection cases of D-052 and the asterisk-form `OPTIONS *` case of D-442 SHALL run against both the in-memory adapter and the TinyHttpd adapter with identical status results.
No size, count or time limit SHALL default to unlimited.
Each (미확정) decision SHALL be recorded with its reason in the commit or pull request that makes it.
A wave MUST NOT remove or change a public signature of `RestApp`, `Request`, `Response` or the `HttpAdapter` SPI that an earlier wave added, and adds new methods only.
Every test that starts a server SHALL assert after shutdown that no server thread and no temporary upload file of that app remains.
Security-related log messages MUST NOT contain tokens, passwords, session ids or file content.
Header values produced by the framework (`res.header`, `Set-Cookie`, `Content-Disposition`) SHALL never contain CR or LF.
Every acceptance test T01–T50 SHALL exist as an automated test or a recorded manual check before the run closes.
The full automated suite SHALL pass in `./gradlew build` at the end of the run.
A requirement covering a manual-pending check MUST NOT be promoted to verified.
